definitions.gloss: leaving work; going home from the office
definitions.explanation: The act of leaving one's workplace at the end of the workday.
Permanently leaving one's employment at a company.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{退|たい} (to withdraw, to leave) + ⟦{社|しゃ}→〜社：04660_sha⟧ (company)

TWO MEANINGS:
This word has two distinct meanings depending on context:
1. Daily leaving work (going home)
2. Permanently leaving employment (resignation)

Context usually makes the meaning clear.

CONTRAST WITH ⟦{出社|しゅっしゃ}→出社：06155_shussha⟧:
- ⟦{出社|しゅっしゃ}→出社：06155_shussha⟧: going to work/office
- {退社|たいしゃ}: leaving work

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{辞職|じしょく}→辞職：06157_jishoku⟧: resignation (more formal)
- ⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧: retirement/leaving employment
- ⟦{帰宅|きたく}→帰宅：02546_kitaku⟧: going home

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{定時|ていじ}→定時：07697_teiji⟧{退社|たいしゃ}: leaving on time
- {退社|たいしゃ}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: time of leaving work
- ⟦{早期|そうき}→早期：09568_souki⟧{退社|たいしゃ}: early departure from work
